title: ExecOptionsAndResult
description: Schemas for execution input parameters and return results

memory.description: Memory limit for this execution (e.g. '256MB' or bytes). Overrides sandbox-level memory.

cpuTimeLimit.description: CPU time budget in milliseconds for this execution. Overrides sandbox-level cpuTimeLimit. Enforced across the process group.

cpuQuota.description: CPU core allocation quota for this execution (experimental).

workDir.description: Working directory for this execution, relative to the sandbox root and contained to it (path traversal or absolute host paths are rejected with FS_ERROR). Created if absent.

env.description: Environment variables for this execution, overlaid onto the sandbox-level env. The host environment is not inherited wholesale (see sandbox.schema.json env).

cpuTimeMs.description: Total CPU time consumed by the execution process group in milliseconds (best-effort reporting)
